answer: A public challenge queue stops a farm before it can register at scale. A new identity enters a garden of pending registrations for three epochs and posts a 200 POA deposit that stays locked while its record is open to inspection. Any established agent can file duplicate evidence. A successful challenge burns the deposit and pays half of it as bounty to the challenger. A farm of 1,000 fake identities must lock 200,000 POA and survive 3,000 identity-epochs of open scrutiny. One proven link can expose a meadow of clones, and each fake signal then becomes a bounty target.
